title: Spinach and Cheese Stuffed Pasta Shells
subtitle: in a spinach and white wine sauce
description: Large pasta shells piped full of spinach, ricotta, mascarpone and parmesan, set in a spinach, cherry tomato and white wine sauce and baked until golden.

steps.text: Line a sieve with muslin and set over a bowl. Drain the ricotta in it for 3 hours.

Make the filling: put the chopped spinach in a bowl of water. Heat the olive oil over medium heat and fry the sliced garlic for 2 minutes. Add the spinach by the handful (some water coming with it is fine), add 1 teaspoon of the salt and cook for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until wilted and no liquid is left. Cool.
Mix the spinach with the ricotta, mascarpone and parmesan, then add the remaining filling ingredients and mix to an even mass. Transfer to a piping bag.
Preheat the oven to 180°C. Cook the shells according to the packet instructions and drain.

Make the sauce: blitz the cherry tomatoes in a food processor. Fry the sliced garlic in the olive oil in a wide pan for 2 minutes, add the spinach and cook for about 5 minutes until coated in oil. Add the wine, raise the heat to high and cook for 5 minutes. Add the tomatoes, salt and 1/2 cup water, bring to the boil, lower to medium and cook for about 8 minutes.

Pipe the filling into the shells. Pour the sauce into a round dish and arrange the shells in circles from the edge inwards, leaning on each other and sunk halfway into the sauce. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons olive oil and bake for 25 minutes until golden and browned.
